item.title: Microsoft Teams: Modernized Gallery view in Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: The updated Gallery view in Teams Rooms on Android prioritizes video on the meeting stage, arranges participants in consistent aspect ratios, and minimizes movement of participant tiles on stage. item.description: The new chats and channels experience introduced quick views at the top of the chat and channels list. These are views into mentions, followed threads and more. item.description: We're upgrading our topic assignment pipeline to be powered by Copilot, delivering significantly improved accuracy in categorizing survey comments into relevant topics. item.description: We are introducing explicit recording and transcription consent support for PSTN participants joining Microsoft Teams meetings in GCC High and DoD environments. item.description: Feature description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) based agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat will now be able to surface rich, interactive UI widgets directly within chat. This enhancement enables developers to deliver more engaging and structured agent interactions. Users will experience these widg (GA: August CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft 365: Introducing Exchange Online Cross-tenant Message Recall
item.description: We're enhancing the Exchange Online Message Recall feature to add support for cross-tenant recalls. Today, you can recall messages only within your organization. Cross-tenant recall will let you recall messages sent to other organizations that add your tenant to their recall allow list. (GA: August CY2026) — Microsoft 365

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Specify who has control of production tools in Teams meetings and events
item.description: A new meeting option for Teams meetings with presenters and events that enables organizers to designate 'Who has control of production tools' during the event. Users defined here will have access to the controls in 'Manage What Attendees See' and the ‘Green Room'. (GA: August CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: OneDrive: Refreshed Libraries View in OneDrive Web
item.description: We're replacing the existing More places experience in OneDrive Web with a refreshed Libraries view. Users can see more recently accessed libraries, navigate to default document libraries for Teams and favorite SharePoint sites, and use new filtering, sorting, and view options. (GA: July CY2026) — OneDrive

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Expand presenter visibility in 'Manage what attendees see' for Teams events
item.description: Users will now be able to resize and expand the presenter panel in 'Manage what attendees see' options for Teams events. This feature helps make it easier to view, manage, and switch between presenters during events. (GA: August CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: SharePoint: New SharePoint Experience
item.description: We are introducing a reimagined SharePoint experience designed to be simple and intuitive, centered on the core jobs of discovering knowledge, publishing content, and building solutions. item.title: OneDrive: Exclude specific folders from syncing
item.description: OneDrive for Windows and Mac will let users exclude specific folders from syncing, so folders that do not belong in the cloud, such as developer tooling folders like PowerShell modules, Visual Studio configuration, and node modules, stay local on the device instead of uploading to OneDrive. item.description: We are improving the live captions experience in Microsoft Teams with new viewing layouts and streamlined configuration options. item.description: After meeting recap is automatically generated in the translation language chosen during the meeting, users can continue to change the language of the meeting recap after its generated. (GA: August CY2026) — Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.description: When a Teams Rooms on Android is invited as a meeting presenter, the front-of-room display defaults to the attendee view. item.description: The Microsoft OneDrive apps for iOS and Android will let users annotate PDFs protected by a Microsoft Purview Information Protection sensitivity label that applies encryption — without removing or weakening the label. item.description: Enable aggregation of DLP alerts based on common entities user even when multiple rules are matched. (GA: August CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.description: Organizations can allow external presenters to manage Teams events by granting them access to production controls. Federated (B2B) and guest users can be specified in the "Who has control of production tools" setting, enabling trusted external presenters to run events and manage what attendees see. (GA: August CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.description: Users can more easily use their laptop for meetings and collaboration in spaces like focus or huddle rooms that don’t yet have a Teams Rooms system. item.description: Teams rooms on Windows and Android, Panels and Teams Phones now supports Entra Resource Accounts for secure, passwordless sign-in that separates device and user identities. item.description: Administrators can enable automatic recording and transcription for Teams call queues. item.description: Localized default email templates for Mark and Notify in Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will improve user notifications in their preferred language. This affects end users reporting messages. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Defender for Office 365

item.description: Express voice enrollment makes registering your voice in Teams fast and easy. The chat panel will open by default in gallery view, allowing participants in Teams Room on Android to quickly see ongoing meeting chat when they join. Admins can configure this default device behavior, and users can close the panel in one tap during meetings.
